facts.claim: 國防部統計自10月31日上午6時至11月1日上午6時，偵獲7艘共艦、2艘公務船及32架次共機。
其中26架次共機逾越台灣海峽中線，侵擾北部、中部、西南及東部空域。
國軍運用任務機艦及岸置飛彈系統嚴密監控與應處。

zh.title: 7艘共艦、32架次共機現蹤，26架次越中線擾台，國軍嚴密監控
zh.summary: 國防部公布10月31日上午6時至11月1日上午6時的共機艦動態，偵獲7艘共艦、2艘公務船及32架次共機，其中26架次逾越海峽中線，侵擾北部、中部、西南及東部空域，國軍以任務機艦及岸置飛彈系統嚴密監控與應處。
body: 國防部11月1日上午公布共機艦動態，統計自10月31日上午6時起至11月1日上午6時止，共偵獲7艘共艦、2艘公務船及32架次共機，其中26架次共機逾越台灣海峽中線，侵擾北部、中部、西南及東部空域。
國防部強調，國軍運用任務機艦及岸置飛彈系統，對此次偵獲的共機艦動態嚴密監控與應處。

en.title: 7 PLA vessels and 32 aircraft sorties detected around Taiwan; 26 crossed the median line
en.summary: Taiwan's Ministry of National Defense said it detected 7 PLA vessels, 2 official vessels and 32 PLA aircraft sorties in the 24 hours to 6 a.m. on November 1, with 26 sorties crossing the Taiwan Strait median line into airspace north, central, southwest and east of Taiwan; the military said it monitored and responded with mission aircraft, vessels and shore-based missile systems.
body: Taiwan's Ministry of National Defense on November 1 released PLA aircraft and vessel activity covering 6 a.m. on October 31 to 6 a.m. on November 1, detecting 7 PLA vessels, 2 official vessels and 32 PLA aircraft sorties, of which 26 crossed the Taiwan Strait median line and entered airspace to the north, centre, southwest and east of Taiwan.
The ministry said Taiwan's military used mission aircraft and vessels as well as shore-based missile systems to closely monitor and respond to the activity.
